about: Bambu Studio CLI ground truth for the native slicer. Regenerate with slicer/calibration/build_truth.py; inputs and reasons in cases.json.

provenance.totals.print_time_s: SOURCE: Bambu result.json sliced_plates[0].total_predication (equals slice_info prediction and the G-code header total)
provenance.totals.total_g/model_g/purge_g: SOURCE: result.json filaments total_used_g and main_used_g; purge = total - main
provenance.totals.tower_g: SOURCE (parsed): positive E under '; FEATURE: Prime tower' in the G-code, converted with the config's filament_diameter and filament_density
provenance.totals.flush_g: SOURCE (parsed): ';VG1 E' lines inside '; VFLUSH_START/END' (virtual moves the firmware executes as M620.10 L<flush_length>), new filament
provenance.totals.filament_changes: SOURCE (parsed): T<n> commands (n < 1000) that change the tool
provenance.totals.nozzle_changes: SOURCE (parsed): tool changes whose filaments sit on different nozzles in slice_info filament_maps; nozzle_change_markers counts '; NOZZLE_CHANGE_START' (absent in these slices)
provenance.totals.flushes: SOURCE (parsed): '; VFLUSH_START/END' blocks with flush length > 0 (flush_blocks counts all, including 0 mm ones on a nozzle switch)
provenance.totals.filament_change_times_result_json: SOURCE: result.json; equals totals.flushes (tool changes with a flush) in all 20 cases
provenance.features.*.time_s: SOURCE: result.json feature_type_times. Everything except Travel sums to total_predication; Travel is already inside the other features
provenance.features.*.e_mm/path_mm/g: SOURCE (parsed): extrusion moves (E > 0 with XY motion) by '; FEATURE:' label; 'Flush' is empty (flush is virtual)
provenance.per_layer.t0_s/t_s: SOURCE (parsed, approximate): elapsed time pinned at each M73 P (floor of percent) or R (floor of minutes left) change, interpolated between pins by distance / feedrate. Error is about 1% of total time or 60 s, whichever is smaller, per pin interval
provenance.run.slicer_wall_s: SOURCE: measured wall clock of the Bambu CLI child process on this Mac, one slice at a time
provenance.run.bambu_internal_ms: SOURCE: result.json timings; units look like milliseconds (ASSUMED from comparison with wall clock)
provenance.slice_report: p2p_threemf.slice_check SliceReport for the same run (our gate's numbers; purge_grams there is an estimate)
